missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const team=Array.isArray(body.team_members)?body.team_members:[];if(team.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'team_members must be a non-empty array'}}];const backlog=Array.isArray(body.backlog_items)?body.backlog_items:[];if(backlog.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'backlog_items must be a non-empty array'}}];const duration=Math.min(30,Math.max(1,parseInt(body.sprint_duration_days)||14));const formattedTeam=team.slice(0,15).map(m=>({name:(m.name||'Member').trim(),role:m.role||'engineer',availabilityPercent:Math.min(100,Math.max(0,parseFloat(m.availability_percent)||100)),skills:Array.isArray(m.skills)?m.skills:(m.skills||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean),plannedPTO:parseInt(m.planned_pto_days)||0}));const formattedBacklog=backlog.slice(0,40).map((item,i)=>({id:item.id||('BLG-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),title:(item.title||'').trim().slice(0,150),storyPoints:parseFloat(item.story_points)||null,priority:item.priority||'medium',requiredSkills:Array.isArray(item.required_skills)?item.required_skills:(item.required_skills||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean),blocked:item.blocked===true||item.blocked==='true',estimate:item.estimate||'',type:item.type||'story'}));const totalCapacity=formattedTeam.reduce((s,m)=>{const workDays=duration-m.plannedPTO;const effectiveDays=workDays*(m.availabilityPercent/100)*0.7;return s+effectiveDays;},0);return[{json:{valid:true,sprintName:body.sprint_name.trim(),sprintDurationDays:duration,sprintGoal:(body.sprint_goal||'').slice(0,300),team:formattedTeam,backlog:formattedBacklog,velocityHistory:Array.isArray(body.velocity_history)?body.velocity_history:(body.velocity_history||'').split(',').map(Number).filter(n=>!isNaN(n)),totalRawCapacityDays:parseFloat(totalCapacity.toFixed(1)),teamSize:formattedTeam.length,replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You plan sprint capacity for engineering teams. You match backlog items to team members based on skills and availability, flag blockers and risks, ensure the sprint goal is achievable, and surface items that don't fit so the team can have an honest conversation. You use 70% of raw available time as effective capacity (accounting for meetings, reviews, and interruptions). Always respond in valid JSON only.
